results.description: Classified cross-country results linked from the accepted FIS schedule

participants.description: The official FIS startlist for the target race

reasons: The feed contains domestic results outside the accepted FIS results boundary.
The legacy mapper can fuzzy-match an identity or create a negative synthetic athlete ID.
The legacy merge renumbers races in the combined history instead of preserving accepted FIS race identities.
The checked-in legacy feed contained future-dated result rows when audited on 2026-11-23.
No hosted acquisition, Elo replay, prediction, or publication workflow consumes the combined legacy files.
reactivation_requirements: Approve an authoritative source and publication contract.
Add fixture-backed parsing tests that reject future result dates.
Replace fuzzy automatic identity binding with exact reviewed mappings.
Preserve accepted FIS race identities during isolated Elo replay.
Demonstrate prediction parity and obtain an explicit owner approval.
